_meta.description: Key milestones of Line 9, oldest first. 'date_precision' is day, month or year. 'kind' is planning, approval, tender, award, construction, related or future. Only events whose source was read are listed.

events.title: State Cabinet approves Lines 9 and 7A
events.summary: The Maharashtra Cabinet approves the Dahisar to Mira-Bhayandar line, 10.41 km and elevated, with the Andheri to airport line, at Rs 6,607 crore for both.

events.title: Civil contract to J Kumar Infraprojects
events.summary: J Kumar Infraprojects announces a Rs 1,998 crore letter of acceptance from MMRDA for the viaduct, ramps and the underground station of Line 9 and its Andheri to airport arm (package CA-48).

events.title: Track contract: Rahee lowest bidder
events.summary: Rahee Infratech is the lowest of four bidders for the ballastless track from Dahisar (E) to Bhayandar (CA-167), at Rs 91.86 crore against an estimate of Rs 88.28 crore plus tax.

events.title: Power contract: Leena-Umesh JV lowest bidder
events.summary: Leena Powertech and Umesh Brothers bid lowest for the power and overhead wire of Lines 9 and 7A (CA-176); the award is reported in June 2025.

events.title: Dongri depot to Rithwik-Soma JV
events.summary: MMRDA awards the depot at Dongri, for the whole Red Line, to Rithwik-Soma JV at Rs 701.94 crore, for 52 months (CA-207).

events.title: Steel span over the railway at Bhayandar
events.summary: A 65 m composite steel girder of about 700 t is launched over the Western Railway at Bhayandar (W) in three night blocks, on the double-decker stretch.

events.title: Safety commissioner inspects Dahisar to Kashigaon
events.summary: The Commissioner of Metro Rail Safety completes an inspection of the 4.4 km Dahisar to Kashigaon stretch, with Line 2B.

events.title: Safety clearance for Phase I
events.summary: The safety commissioner's final clearance for the 4.973 km from Dahisar (E) to Kashigaon is reported; trains are to be kept at Line 7's Charkop depot.

events.title: Trial run, Kashigaon to Dahisar
events.summary: A trial run is held between Kashigaon and Dahisar; the opening planned for 3 Apr is put back.

events.title: Phase I opens: Dahisar (E) to Kashigaon
events.summary: The Chief Minister opens Phase I, 4.7 km with four stations; trains run through from Gundavali on Line 7. Open to riders from 8 Apr.

events.title: Power on from Kashigaon
events.summary: MMRDA switches on the overhead power over the 5.8 km from Kashigaon to Subhash Chandra Bose Stadium; checks and then trial runs are to follow.

events.title: Rest of the line, reported target
events.summary: Kashigaon to Subhash Chandra Bose Stadium is expected to be completed in December, after the safety commissioner's inspection (MMRDA, as reported).
